title: Altazimuth Pavilion, Royal Observatory Greenwich

groundCutout.basis: Occupied Altazimuth footprint only; retain original approaches and independent buildings. Ground-cutout coordinates are quantized to1mm to avoid Float32 boundary ambiguity; original elevations and the mapped building-ownership mask remain unchanged.

buildingCutout.basis: Shared campus Q192988 plus unique way268533441/native35184640622273. The mapped rounded body with two north/south projecting entrances establishes identity and orientation. Own anchor raw[35.8,55], internalX east,Z south, heading0 baked into geometry. Photos from opposite ends establish different north/south gables; the vane bearing and exact ornamental inventories remain approximate. Parent plus its five contained building parts are owned; retain all other campus buildings, including the southern planetarium.
